text:
Eun: Heads-up: quick smoke for Aurora-v2 q4 build shows detok/tokenization drift on CJK + RTL. Short summary: extra space before Japanese/Chinese punctuation, ZWJ dropped in emoji sequences, Arabic punctuation separated from adjacent word. Small repro and logs below. @Haruto @Fatima please triage.

Diego: thanks. minimal repro?

Eun: ran a 80-sample roundtrip locally:
```bash
python tools/roundtrip_eval.py \
  --model aurora-v2 --quant q4 --n 80 \
  --locales ja,zh,ar --detok auto \
  --out /tmp/aurora_q4_rt.jsonl
```

Eun: deltas (detoked strings):
- float ja: "東京に行った。"
- q4 detok: "東京に行った  。"  <-- extra space before full-stop

- float zh: "😊‍欢"
- q4 detok: "😊  欢"  <-- ZWJ removed, gap inserted

- float ar: "أهلاثا،أي"
- q4 detok: "أهلاثا ، أي"  <-- spaced comma

Haruto: looks like either tokenizer serialization mismatch or a detok normalization flag different in quant runtime. did we change normalize_zwj or merge_punct recently?

Fatima: we landed a tokenizer normalizer PR (normalize_zwsp) a few weeks back. float images pulled the new vocab; some quant images may have an older vocab baked in.

ci-bot: Triggering canary with pinned tokenizer v2026-03-05 and explicit detok modes. Job: canary/4999991234-1.

Haruto: also request raw token id dumps for failing samples (byte-level) so we can check split boundaries.

Diego: i'll run control against previous q4 build (q4-2026-03-07) to see if regression is new.

Eun: sample log excerpt from current run:
```
INFO tokenizer=v2026-03-12 loaded
INFO model checkpoint: aurora-v2-q4-2026-03-20
DEBUG sample[14] locale=ja input="これは東京。" detok="これは東京  。"
DEBUG sample[33] locale=zh input="😊‍欢" detok="😊  欢"
DEBUG sample[57] locale=ar input="السالام،" detok="السالام ،"
```

Fatima: if token ids match between float and quant then it is detok normalization in runtime. if ids differ, tokenizer mismatch. Haruto - can you bisect tokenizer loader commits since Mar 1?

Haruto: will bisect today morning. also will run a short eval forcing `--detok=legacy` and pin tokenizer to v2026-03-05 to isolate.

Diego: metric snapshot: ja->en BLEU -1.9, zh->en -1.1, ar->en -3.3 (subset with punctuation heavy). chrF stable-ish, COMET drops mostly for arabic samples.

Eun: mitigation thought: temporary route ja/zh/ar traffic to float for 90% until fix, keep 10% on quant for telemetry. need SRE approval.

Fatima: agree on plan. i'll coordinate a quant image rebuild that pins tokenizer serialization and copies updated runtime config to quant fastpath. target: 6h.

Haruto: action items: 1) bisect tokenizer loader (Haruto) 2) run pinned-tokenizer + legacy detok (Haruto) 3) rebuild quant images with synced runtime config (Fatima) 4) consider routing fallback (Diego/Runs SRE).

Eun: thanks. will paste token-id dumps and canary results here when done. :thumbsup:
